milestones.title: Sufficiency — Combinators and Extended Polynomials (p. 113)
milestones.milestone_description: Proves that every extended polynomial is λ-definable over the Church numeral type `ν`.

milestones.title: Normal-Form Analysis — Subterms of Type `0 → 0` (p. 114, clauses (1)-(3))
milestones.milestone_description: Classifies all well-typed subterms of the normal form `r` of `t F₁ ... Fₖ α`.

milestones.title: Polynomial Evaluation Lemma on Positive Numerals (p. 114)
milestones.milestone_description: Establishes by induction on clauses (1)-(3) that substituting positive Church numerals reduces every type `0 → 0` subterm to `α` or `λy. α^{P(n⃗)} z`.
